applicability: Digital-audio clock-drift buffer-margin check between two independent clock domains sharing a fixed-size buffer with periodic resync
assumptions: each clock domain has a constant, independent ppm frequency error over the resync interval
no continuous ASRC/resampling correction between resyncs
buffer nominally sits half-full so drift in either direction consumes the same half-buffer margin
excluded: continuous ASRC systems that never hit a hard resync boundary
uncertainty: Direct arithmetic from the standard ppm (parts-per-million frequency error) definition, not a fitted or externally-sourced coefficient; hand-verified before use (e.g. 48000 Hz at 100 ppm relative error -> 4.8 samples/s).
limits_policy: Explicit caller-declared buffer size and resync interval, not a presumed platform default.
